summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the AI Marketing Analyzer (Google Ads, GA4, Search Console + OpenAI). 6/6 backend tests pass after fixing MongoDB _id leakage on /api/marketing/analyses and /api/marketing/actions-log. Frontend /marketing page loads with real data (32K sessions, 6 stat cards, 7 Google Ads campaigns with 6 pause + 1 enable buttons, 30 GSC queries, traffic table, AI Analiz tab). Date range selector, Baglanti Testi (all 4 services Bagli), tab navigation and sidebar 'AI Pazarlama' nav all verified working.

minor.issue: Previously exposed MongoDB _id (ObjectId as str). FIXED by projecting {_id:0} in find(). Frontend also updated to key past analyses by created_at fallback.

passed_tests: GET /api/marketing/dashboard returns ga4_overview (sessions, revenue), ads_campaigns (7), gsc_queries (30), ads_keywords (list)
POST /api/marketing/ai-analyze {focus:'genel'} -> returns 'analysis' text > 50 chars and persists to Mongo (verified via /analyses)
UI: 6 stat cards present (stat-oturumlar, stat-kullanicilar, stat-sayfa-goruntulenme, stat-reklam-harcamasi, stat-satis, stat-gelir)
UI: Google Ads tab shows campaigns-table with 7 rows, 6 pause + 1 enable action buttons
UI: SEO & Search tab shows gsc-table with 30 rows
UI: AI Analiz tab shows start-analysis-btn ('Analiz Baslat')
UI: Date range select changes Son 30 Gun -> Son 7 Gun, dashboard refetches
UI: Baglanti Testi shows 'Tum API baglantilari basarili' toast and connection-status panel with all 4 services 'Bagli'
UI: Sidebar has 'AI Pazarlama' item that navigates to /marketing
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2972 lines - should be split into modular routers (marketing, price-tracking, auth, products) per 700-line guideline.
Ads-action endpoint intentionally not tested (mutates real campaigns). Consider adding a dry_run flag and rate-limiting to prevent accidental mass-pause.
AI analyze endpoint has 180s theoretical latency (OpenAI). Consider streaming response or a background job pattern for better UX in the future.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/MarketingPage.js (pastAnalyses map key falls back to id/index when _id absent)
seed_data_creation: One AI analysis document created by test (POST /api/marketing/ai-analyze focus=genel). Persisted intentionally to verify /analyses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Marketing dashboard is fully wired to real Google APIs and OpenAI. All 3 Google APIs return ok:true. Do NOT test /api/marketing/ads-action - it mutates real Google Ads campaigns. Fixed _id leakage in /analyses and /actions-log. Frontend key-warnings for past analyses list also fixed to use id/index fallback.
